de.abas.jfop.base.buffer

Interface ScreenEnabledBuffer

  • All Superinterfaces:
    BaseReadableBuffer, Buffer, DbObjectBuffer, MetadataSupport, ReadableBuffer, TableEnabledBuffer, TableModifiableBuffer, WriteableBuffer
    All Known Subinterfaces:
    ParentScreenBuffer, ScreenBuffer

    public interface ScreenEnabledBuffer
extends TableModifiableBuffer
    Any buffer which has access to a screen object has to implements this interface.

    • Method Detail

      • insertRows

        void insertRows(int count,
                boolean optimized)
         throws FOPException
        Inserts some rows at the current position of the table.
        After this operation the table cursor points to the last inserted row.

        Please see the FO online help for further information. The FO commands used here are e.g.

        • german: 
          .MACHE [A]MASKE ZEILE +[O]
        • english: 
          .MAKE [A]SCREEN LINE +[O]

        Parameters:
        count - the number of rows to insert
        optimized - if the option "O" should be used while inserting new row(s)
        Throws:
        FOPException
